The '''Hall of the Tower''' is a place to discuss or debate new ideas for the wiki in general.  Please feel free to post questions, suggestions, and comments not related to specific articles. Questions related to specific articles should be asked on the talk page for that article. <br /><br />
'''This is not a general discussion board.''' To have a general discussion about The Wheel of Time universe use our other board [[Forum:The Inn|The Inn]] or external forums such as [[Dragonmount.com]]'s [http://forums.dragonmount.com/ here] or at Tarvalon.net's [http://www.tarvalon.net/phpbbforum/index.php here]. '''Off-topic posts are subject to deletion.'''
